verdict.rationale: Blink's docs list built-in local commands including cat, grep, ls, cp, mv, mkdir, df and du, and the GitHub README lists curl (with http, https, scp and sftp support), so most of the story's named commands run directly in the app. The listed command set has no mention of tar. missing for 10: evidence that tar is included, independent or hands-on corroboration of running local commands.
